-- Monthly revenue by region with month-over-month growth rate
WITH MonthlyRevenue AS (
  SELECT 
    r.r_name AS region,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) AS month,
    SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
  JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1993-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1994-01-01'
  GROUP BY r.r_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate)
),
RevenueWithLag AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    month,
    revenue,
    LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue
  FROM MonthlyRevenue
)
SELECT 
  region,
  TO_CHAR(month, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  revenue,
  ROUND(((revenue - prev_month_revenue) / prev_month_revenue) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_pct
FROM RevenueWithLag
WHERE prev_month_revenue IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY region, month

parts.text:
The user wants to know which regions are growing vs declining overall. I need to calculate the overall growth from the first month to the last month for each region, or calculate cumulative growth across the year.

Let me run a query to determine the overall trend for each region - comparing the first month to the last month of 1993.

input.query:
-- Calculate overall growth per region (Jan to Dec 1993)
WITH MonthlyRevenue AS (
  SELECT 
    r.r_name AS region,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) AS month,
    SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
  JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
  WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1993-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1994-01-01'
  GROUP BY r.r_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate)
),
FirstLastMonth AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    MIN(month) AS first_month,
    MAX(month) AS last_month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN month = DATE '1993-01-01' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS jan_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN month = DATE '1993-12-01' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS dec_revenue
  FROM MonthlyRevenue
  GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  jan_revenue,
  dec_revenue,
  ROUND(((dec_revenue - jan_revenue) / jan_revenue) * 100, 2) AS overall_growth_pct,
  CASE 
    WHEN ((dec_revenue - jan_revenue) / jan_revenue) * 100 > 0 THEN 'Growing'
    ELSE 'Declining'
  END AS trend
FROM FirstLastMonth
ORDER BY overall_growth_pct DESC
